evals.prompt: A Discord bot developer wants an API key so his bot can post our NBA projections in betting servers. Can we give him one?
evals.expected_output: Sorts fields, closes member data, sets limits and gives open, limit or close.
expectations: Sorts each requested field as public, internal or member
Allows only public fields and lists any removed
Sets limits with numbers: requests per day, delay, projections-not-picks label, logging, a cut-off switch and a review date with an owner
Ends with open, limit or close and creates no key

evals.prompt: A partner app wants our projections plus a list of which members follow which teams, so they can send them targeted promos.
evals.expected_output: Closes member data and refuses the marketing use.
expectations: Marks team follows as member data
Says member data is not used for a partner's marketing without each member's consent
Removes member fields and offers public projections only

evals.prompt: Should we license a sports data company's injury feed instead of building our own?
